text: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.
script:
Here is a short script based on John 3:16:

**Hook**
"God's love knows no bounds."

**Context**
"The Bible says God so loved the world, He gave His one and only Son to save us from destruction."

**Application**
"This means I don't have to earn my way to heaven - just believe in Jesus!"

**Call to action**
"So choose faith today and experience eternal life."
